unit_note: a PAIR is one (satellite, attribute); a COLUMN is one map row writing that attribute. The informative figure is how many PAIRS the precedence actually fires on, measured here from the spec.
never_report_note: 'R8 fires on 62 of 62' is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION of an input set DEFINED as the pairs having writers in TWO OR MORE runs, so a single-run pair is 0 by definition for every run. It is never reported as a measurement. That 62 was measured over TWO runs; this build feeds THREE.

profile_scoped_figures.scope_note: THE FIGURES IN THIS BLOCK COVER TWO RUNS ONLY -- the pair named in scope_runs -- because that is the population that existed when the profile was written. opus_health_delta3 is NOT in them. The profile scopes R8 to CROSS-RUN pairs split single-active / multi-active; this build measures over every (satellite, attribute) written by two or more runs on EITHER track, which is a WIDER population over a LARGER run set. Both are stated; they are not reconciled, must not be added, and the profile figures must not be read as describing this build.

near_miss_note: Three different things coincide near 62 and are reconciled NOWHERE: 62 shared vault TABLES (unit = .sql basename in a vault dir), 62 cross-run (satellite, attribute) PAIRS (unit = pair), and 48 shared satellites + 15 anchors = 63 (unit = vault object). Do not add them.
intra_run_fan_in_note: WITHIN one run several views may write one attribute and the map declares NO precedence among them, so max() picks arbitrarily. Declared per attribute in each satellite header; it is the pre-existing single-active fan-in, remedy refuse-and-declare.
